DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Malignancy (Suspected)

The symptoms of postmenopausal bleeding combined with an adnexal mass are highly indicative of gynecologic pathology, whereas pyelonephritis is ruled out by your lack of fever, flank pain, and urinary symptoms. Please await the results of the Pelvic Ultrasound and Serum CA-125 which I have ordered to confirm the nature of the mass.
